notes.title: Update 0.7.0.0 - 02/04/2022 - Dangers
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First of all, we would like to apologize for the delay, since we wanted to release this update on 31/03/2022. However, we hope that you will like the new features.

[i]There lies danger in the dark.[/i] Evil robots from the unknown attack your village at night and try to hinder your villages growth!

Luckily, you can fight them off by building [b]Barracks[/b] which allow you to train [b]Soldiers [/b]and lead them into the fight!

Other Changes:
- Fixed the screen looking washed out after the last update
- Added torch fire to the beach torches

Thank you for your support and good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 0.6.1.0 - 09/02/2022
notes.content:
Adds new, progressively unlocked tutorials explaining the game in more detail.

Other changes:
- Fixed an error when loading  the game
- Fixed Continue button being available even if no savegame exists
- Fixed Villager Menu not showing after clicking on villager
- Forester Villagers now only chop selected trees
